authorization: Author confirmed endpoint and T2 and requested small real verification followed by P1, without large experiments
run_count_unit: top-level independent experiment attempts; RH window optimize calls are reported separately
wall_scope: cumulative input prepare + five micro checks + controller execution sessions; excludes human waiting and separately reported read-only post-analysis
micro_gate: All five hand-checks must pass or stop subsequent solver stages
stage_gate: Prepare all immutable inputs before comparisons; never silently rerun or overwrite results
incomplete_runs: Record failures, partial and NOT_RUN_BUDGET in denominators; never rank their costs against completed horizons
